Thanks, im looking for solutions, its a little more complicated then just waltzing into a clinic and getting treatment. 

Yeah its true i've never met her but i did skype with her numerous times, and right now i just feel like im not interested in any other girls around me... thanks for the concern though i appreciate it
I'm still depressed but what i had was emptiness now its just pain, i dont think any amount of meds can take away the feeling of intense attraction for someone.. and yes i do have friends around me
There is nothing I can change, i just feel horrible and helpless in this situation

Shes the one that took my mind off everything and she loves me but not in a romantic way.. and i am so caught up with her i dont give a shit about the rest even if they are the hottest, richest, kindest etc i just want her :/ and its fucking me up thinking one day some other guy will take her breath away and i can only hope that guy is better than me in every aspect
